title: Skilled Hands
paragraphs: Ren and Itsuki immediately pointed at me, as if to say, “That’s it.”
Energetic bunch, aren’t they?
“Why are you both pointing at me in perfect sync?”
“It’s completely pointless. Ren’s suggestion is the most efficient.”
“No way! I just got over my motion sickness. I want to rest after recovering.”
“You had a rough time yesterday and the day before, huh? Well, your level is high enough already, so let’s go with that!”

In the end, Ren and Itsuki forcibly decided that I would spend the afternoon under their so-called “supervision,” which was really just their excuse to take a break. At this point, me being “monitored” seems to be the default, but I don’t particularly mind.
“We’re back! Kō’s hungry!”
“Ah, okay. Want to eat some of the monster meat we hunted yesterday?”
“Yeah! Iwatani, prepare and cook it!”
For once, Father’s face stiffened with hesitation.
“Sounds wonderful. I, too, appreciate Naofumi-sama’s cooking.”
“Yay! Sakura’s looking forward to it!”
Father shot a pleading look at Ren and Itsuki. The two just tilted their heads in confusion.
“Is there something wrong?”
“Well… I’ve never actually butchered an entire monster before. Sakura-chan already drained the blood on her own, though.”
“Didn’t you do it the day before yesterday?”
“That time, Motoyasu-kun had already chopped it into pieces. It was basically just a pile of meat by then.”
“Then—”
Ren and Itsuki turned their eyes toward me.
What?
“I only hacked it apart roughly. In this case, it’d be best for Father or maybe Ren, since he could use a blade designed for butchering.”

Skill bonuses exist, after all. Since Father uses a shield, his skill bonuses for this kind of task might be on the lower side. On the other hand, Ren uses a sword. And since knives and short swords exist, he should be a good fit for this.
“If you copy a butchering knife from the market, you should be able to process it decently well, even at Father’s level.”
“Wait, I’M the one doing it!?”
Ren looked to Father for help. But Father just shook his head furiously.
“Itsuki!”
“Ugh… that trauma from before…”
“Stop! Now I’m remembering it too!”
“A person just… sinking in…”
“Naofumi! Stop!”
“So… Iwatani-dono and the others have gone through some truly horrifying experiences, haven’t they?”
“Huh?”
For some reason, Éclair was looking at them with sympathy while Yuki-chan and the others tilted their heads in confusion. This reaction is common among Filolials, including Filo-tan.
“Now that I think about it, the fact that we were able to eat meat so casually after witnessing such a gruesome scene might make us seem like psychos.”
“When you’re hungry, anything tastes good.”
“Ren and Itsuki were too busy suffering from motion sickness to care, right? And I was trying to push it out of my mind while also wanting to show my gratitude.”
“You never know what will turn out to be a blessing.”
Suddenly, Father and the others’ energy seemed to drain away.

What are they so terrified of? Well, I understand lingering feelings from the first time you hunt monsters in another world, but at this point, they should be used to it. Father, Itsuki, and Ren had all gotten accustomed to it in previous loops, after all.
“When you defeat a monster, of course there’s going to be blood.”
“That’s not exactly what I meant…”
“Well, I’ll try my best to take care of it this time, but Ren, Itsuki, you both need to get used to it too. Otherwise, you’ll just end up being high-level people who can’t even fight properly.”
“Sigh… So this is how we grow, huh?”
“Feels like we’re losing something important along the way.”
“No… Maybe we’re just getting tainted. Becoming indifferent to the sight of blood…”
And with that, Father and the others began preparing for departure.

Indifferent to the sight of blood, huh? That’s not something that bothers me. Among the Filolials, many live in the wild. And in the wild, it’s survival of the fittest. If you dwell on it too much, you’ll never get anywhere.
“You can’t solve everything with just dreams, huh?”
“That’s right… Originally, maybe we were supposed to get used to it little by little.”
“In a game, you’d just check the loot and move on, but this is reality, after all.”

That remark left an impression. After that, Ren and Itsuki got some motion sickness medicine from me, and Father cooked up a meal for Yuki-chan and the others using leftover meat. Ren and Itsuki said they’d eat later, around lunchtime.
“Eclair-san, what will you do?”
“I will serve as a guard for Iwatani-dono and Kitamura-dono.”
“And Sakura-chan?”
“Sakura will protect Naofumi!”
“I see. Well, it’d be helpful if you could also assist with errands, so I’ll be counting on you.”
“Okay!”
In front of the inn, Father was seeing off Yuki-chan and the others, who were carrying Ren and Itsuki. Of course, I was there to see them off as well.
“Naofumi, don’t go chatting up the townspeople so carelessly. If they find out who you really are, it’ll be a huge problem.”
“I know, I know. I’ve gotten a lot stronger now, so you don’t have to worry so much. If anything, shouldn’t you be more concerned about Motoyasu-kun?”
“…Yeah, that’s true.”
“I assure you, I have no issues whatsoever.”
“Coming from you, that doesn’t sound convincing at all.”
How unfair. I am simply doing my best to resolve things sincerely. I just don’t hesitate when it comes to choosing my methods.
“Well then, we’ll be off.”
“Take care. Don’t go dropping Ren or Itsuki along the way.”
As soon as Father said that, Yuki-chan and the others dashed off. Their departure was just as elegant as ever.
“Alright then… Let’s go get the thread turned into fabric. After that, we’ll check on Motoyasu-kun’s work, then prepare for cooking.”
“Got it.”
“Okay!”
“I’m looking forward to this!”

And so, as attendants to the angelic Sakura-chan, we headed to the shop to have the thread turned into fabric. Thanks to Sakura-chan’s wings, we were able to move around without drawing too much suspicion. While waiting for the thread to be processed into fabric, I borrowed some equipment from the shop and started working on pattern templates. There was no problem using the same design as before. That said, Sakura-chan keeps shifting between big and small. I have no idea what triggers it.
“You’re pretty efficient.”
“Hmm. I don’t have much experience with delicate tasks like this, but I can sense Kitamura-dono’s skill.”

Once the fabric was ready, we returned to the inn to start making clothes. Threading the needle, I stitched carefully. Using a sewing machine would be good too—it’s precise and sturdy. Sewing by hand inevitably results in some rough areas. Even so, I did my best to make it as detailed as possible.
“Wow… Motoyasu-kun, you’re actually pretty good at sewing.”
“It’s the same refined touch as when Iwatani-dono cooks.”
“Eclair-san, you’re overpraising me. My cooking is actually pretty random, you know?”
“Stitch, stitch~”
What a heartwarming conversation. Father was watching me closely.
I’ll do my best!
“Sakura’s bored… I’m tired of this.”
“Just a little longer. In the meantime, why don’t we play a game together? After that, it’s time to prepare food.”
“Okay!”

Father and Sakura-chan started playing in the room. Éclair was practicing her swings. While we were all engaged in our activities, time passed, and Ren and Itsuki returned. Ren and Itsuki took turns relaxing in the room.
“By the way,”
I turned to Ren and asked.
“What is it?”
“You’ve always had a thing for level grinding, but what’s gotten into you now?”
“You’re asking that now? I do like leveling up, but only when the conditions are right.”
“In a country that could be attacked at any moment, there’s no point in grinding levels.”
“From the Shield Hero’s perspective, this country might feel like home to Naofumi, but avoiding war by heading to Faubrey should be our priority.”
“So, once we reach a minimum level of strength… That means the time is near, doesn’t it?”
“Pretty much. In the end, we managed to gain enough levels in this short time. There’s no need to rush any further.”
What a difference from the Ren of the previous world. This version of him is much more composed.
“I plan to talk with Naofumi later about what we’ll do once we arrive in Faubrey.”
“Yeah. Technically, we’re cooperating for now, but considering Naofumi-san’s situation, there’s a chance he’ll return to this country.”
“It’s a comfortable place for Father.”
“Right. We’re heading to Faubrey to prevent the war. Melromarc might not even be in a position for war anymore.”
“Since the higher-ups of the country have already been dealt with.”
“…Yeah.”
Ren crossed his fingers and rested them against his mouth, deep in thought.
“I wonder if there are countries that worship the Sword Hero or the Bow Hero, like how this one worships the Spear Hero?”
“It’s possible.”

Most of the countries I stayed in were just passing points for me. Melromarc was certainly one of the larger nations, but it wasn’t the biggest. There are also countries with complicated histories, like Siltvelt and Schildfrieden. Then there are the small nations Itsuki saved, the ones where the Spirit Tortoise and Phoenix were sealed, and so on. If we look, we might find places that venerate the other heroes as well. This world is vast, after all. There are Dragon Hourglasses all over, meaning there are plenty of places to take part in battles. By traveling the world, the heroes can prevent the Waves before they happen. But if we each had to participate in every single one, we wouldn’t last long. It’s inevitable that we’ll need to take turns acting for the sake of the world. Thankfully, with portals, traveling between locations is easy.
“In that sense, Naofumi is pretty unlucky. I’m a bit worried about him.”
“According to Motoyasu-san, despite everything, his survival rate is oddly high, so he might be fine. If anything, I wonder who has the highest death rate?”
“That would be Itsuki. So far, he’s died more times than anyone else.”
Well, most of those deaths were because of me.
